Premier Outdoor Service

Johnson Lawn Solutions is your one-stop destination for professional outdoor services, delivering expert lawn care, landscaping, hardscaping, and tree services throughout Hudson and the surrounding areas. As a locally owned and operated company, we are committed to quality craftsmanship, dependable service, and customer satisfaction—helping homeowners transform and maintain their properties with reliable, full-service outdoor solutions.

Our Story

Johnson Lawn Solutions is a locally owned landscaping and lawn care company proudly serving Hudson, WI and the surrounding St. Croix County communities. We specialize in professional lawn care, landscaping, hardscaping, tree services, and snow removal designed to enhance curb appeal and protect long-term property value. From routine lawn maintenance and fertilization programs to paver patios, retaining walls, mulch installation, sod installation, and complete landscape transformations, our team delivers reliable, high-quality outdoor solutions.

With a strong focus on craftsmanship, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, we take pride in providing dependable service and clear communication from start to finish. Our experience with western Wisconsin’s soil conditions and seasonal climate allows us to create outdoor spaces that are both functional and built to last. At Johnson Lawn Solutions, our goal is simple: to be your one-stop provider for professional landscaping and lawn care services that keep your property looking its best year-round.

Learn more about our team here

Our Process

We believe in keeping things simple. Here is our step by step process to ensure every solution is a success.

1. Consultation

The consultation stage is where your project begins. We meet with you to discuss your goals, assess your property, and provide a clear, detailed estimate tailored to your needs. This step allows us to understand your vision, offer expert recommendations, and develop a plan that ensures your outdoor project is completed efficiently and to the highest standard.

2. Design and selection

During the design and selection stage, we turn your ideas into a clear, actionable plan. Our team works with you to finalize layouts, materials, and plant selections, ensuring every detail fits your style, budget, and the unique characteristics of your property. This collaborative process helps create a cohesive design that balances aesthetics, functionality, and long-term performance.

In the execution and scheduling stage, we coordinate timelines and begin bringing your project to life. Our team manages every aspect of the installation with clear communication and efficient scheduling to minimize disruption while maintaining high standards of workmanship. We focus on delivering your project on time and with precision, ensuring a smooth and professional build process.

3. Scheduling and execution
